patches.title: Post-Placement New Surface Scan
patches.principle: After placing one of multiple objects, if the source is empty, search a different open surface.
patches.when_to_apply: When you need multiple identical objects and the first source has none left.

patches.title: Task-Appropriate Furniture Start
patches.principle: Begin search at the furniture most likely to contain the target (e.g., desk for stationery, countertop for kitchen).
patches.when_to_apply: At the start of a new task.

patches.title: Avoid Endless Container Loops
patches.principle: After opening several containers with no target, switch to searching open surfaces.
patches.when_to_apply: When you have opened multiple containers without finding the target.
